# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

The DemoScope project welcomes participation from people with different backgrounds and experience levels. We want project spaces to be respectful, constructive, and welcoming.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate, patient, and respectful.
- Discuss ideas and code, not personal traits.
- Give clear, helpful feedback and assume good intent.
- Respect other people’s privacy and intellectual property.
- Keep project discussions relevant and share only information you are authorized to disclose.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, or hateful language.
- Trolling, deliberate disruption, spam, or unsolicited promotion.
- Sharing someone’s private information without permission.
- Posting passwords, access tokens, session data, private VACNet invitation or guest links, or private clip information.
- Encouraging people to bypass access controls or misuse VACNet or other services.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies in DemoScope project spaces, including GitHub Issues, pull requests, Discussions, and code reviews, and when someone is representing the project in public spaces.

## Reporting and enforcement

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/ebayybe/DemoScope/issues) to request a private way to contact the maintainer. Do not include sensitive details in a public issue. For abusive content on GitHub, you can also use [GitHub’s reporting tools](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/acceptable-use-policies/github-acceptable-use-policies).

Share links and context when safe, but do not publicly disclose private information, credentials, or sensitive evidence. Reports are handled with discretion; confidentiality cannot be guaranteed when using a public issue.

Depending on the circumstances, the maintainer may request a change in behavior, edit or remove content where permitted, lock a discussion, or restrict participation. Decisions are based on severity and context. No response time is guaranteed.

For security vulnerabilities, follow the [Security Policy](https://github.com/ebayybe/DemoScope/blob/main/.github/SECURITY.md) and do not post vulnerability details publicly.
